name: Rubescent-Rift
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs impact-scarred wastelands, stark under a black sky.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
the monolithic structures of unknown origin still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
